objective.text: Preserve paginator links and metadata when transforming the page's records into resources.

difficulty.rationale: Keep pagination context available while transforming the current page’s items.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

stem: A controller calls Model::paginate(20), then passes only $page->items() to ItemResource::collection. Pagination links disappear. Which change preserves them?

options.text: Pass the paginator itself to ItemResource::collection($page).
options.rationale: The resource collection recognizes a paginator and can produce its links and metadata alongside transformed items.

options.text: Pass count($page->items()) as the second argument to collection.
options.rationale: An item count does not reconstruct the paginator’s URL and page metadata.
options.misconception: An item count does not reconstruct the paginator’s URL and page metadata.

options.text: Call values() on collect($page->items()) before wrapping it.
options.rationale: Reindexing plain items still discards the paginator context.
options.misconception: Reindexing plain items still discards the paginator context.

options.text: Add a public links property to every item model.
options.rationale: Per-model properties do not restore the response’s paginator integration.
options.misconception: Per-model properties do not restore the response’s paginator integration.
